subject.title: [Bug]: Codex-backed Telegram turns repeatedly time out waiting for turn/completed on 2026.5.27

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both safely recoverable missing-terminal replies and unresolved pre-item or partial-tool stream stalls?
rationale: The merged mitigation intentionally covers only completed assistant output, while the newest evidence identifies a materially different state with no app-server item event or safe reply to deliver; maintainers must choose whether those subtypes remain one reliability program or split into narrower canonical tracking.

options.title: Keep one canonical tracker
options.body: Retain this issue for the full missing-terminal family, documenting pull request 99217 as a partial mitigation and classifying future evidence by lifecycle subtype.

options.title: Split partial-tool stalls
options.body: Move stalls that stop before `item/started` or completed assistant output into a narrower canonical issue while retaining links to this history.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Retain this issue for the full missing-terminal family, documenting pull request 99217 as a partial mitigation and classifying future evidence by lifecycle subtype.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently implemented and validated the recovery boundary separating safe completed output from active or unsafe work.
